review_evidence: README identifies a Lean formalization of Synthetic Differential Geometry following Anders Kock and explicitly lists the Kock–Lawvere axiom, synthetic derivative, chain/power rules, mixed partials, Taylor theorems, and constructive-logic consequences.
SDG/Basic/Defs.lean defines IsKockLawvere_one and IsKockLawvere; SDG/IsKockLawvere_one/Deriv.lean proves derivative properties including taylor_one and deriv_mul.
SDG/IsKockLawvere/Taylor.lean and TaylorMulti.lean prove taylor_k and taylor_multi together with mixed-partial identities; the unit contains a substantial theorem-bearing mathematical development.
summary: Retain SDG: it formalizes synthetic differential geometry, the Kock–Lawvere axioms, synthetic derivatives, mixed partials, and Taylor theorems.
